summary: Stewards, Inc. filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 disclosing that on September 9, 2026 its Board approved a standstill and additional review of a previously contemplated recognition program under the 2024 Equity Incentive Plan. The prior November 2025 authorization covered up to 3,000,000 RSUs, intended as 250,000 each for twelve recipients, but no award agreements were executed, no shares issued, and none are treated as outstanding. Independent directors Graeve, Barsoum and Bode will receive none. Any future awards require Compensation Committee action excluding recipients, executed agreements, and an effective Form S-8; no backdating permitted.
